headline: Theater Tickets and Cascade-Siskiyou Access
reservation: Oregon Shakespeare Festival (OSF) tickets should be booked well in advance, particularly for the outdoor Elizabethan Theatre. While town access is open, specific guided hikes or backcountry stays in nearby national monuments may require permits. Check official OSF and Bureau of Land Management sites for current schedules and rules.

days.title: Gardens and Elizabethan Arts
days.start: Suggested: 9 AM from the Downtown Plaza

stops.name: Lithia Park
stops.detail: Follow the creek trail through 100 acres of manicured gardens and native forest.

stops.name: Oregon Shakespeare Festival Campus
stops.detail: Take a backstage tour or enjoy the free evening Green Show during the summer season.

days.driving: Walking-focused day; local transfers under 15 minutes
days.note: The sulfuric Lithia water fountains in the plaza are a local landmark; the taste is an acquired one.

days.title: Alpine Wildflowers and Watershed Trails

stops.name: Mount Ashland
stops.detail: Drive to the ski area for summer hiking trails with views of Mount Shasta.

stops.name: White Rabbit Trail
stops.detail: Explore the Ashland Watershed's dense forest on this popular local hiking and biking loop.

days.driving: Allow 1 hour for the mountain road; conditions vary by season
days.note: Mount Ashland access roads can be snowy into late spring; check local conditions before driving.

days.title: Lakes and Science Exploration

stops.name: ScienceWorks Hands-On Museum
stops.detail: Engage with interactive exhibits focused on physics, art, and regional biology.

stops.name: Emigrant Lake
stops.detail: Relax by the reservoir for bird watching or seasonal water activities just south of town.

days.driving: Allow 45 minutes for local transit; conditions vary
days.note: Check Emigrant Lake water levels and seasonal slide hours before planning a full lake day.

intel.title: Downtown Congestion
intel.text: Parking near the OSF campus is restricted and fills during show times. Use the public lots a few blocks off Main Street for longer stays.

intel.title: Canyon Dead Zones
intel.text: Signal strength drops quickly when driving into the Cascade-Siskiyou National Monument. Carry physical maps for mountain trailheads.

intel.title: Interstate vs Town
intel.text: Fuel is readily available in Ashland and nearby Medford. Prices may be lower at stations near the I-5 interchanges than in the town center.

intel.title: Theater Call Times
intel.text: Allow 30 minutes for seating before OSF performances. Late seating is often restricted to specific intervals to avoid disrupting the show.

intel.title: Winter Road Safety
intel.text: Interstate 5 over the Siskiyou Summit can require chains during winter storms. Monitor Oregon Department of Transportation reports for passes.

plan.arrival: Arrive at Rogue Valley International-Medford Airport (MFR) and drive 20-30 minutes south on I-5 to reach Ashland's historic district.
plan.vehicle: A standard car is sufficient for town and major trailheads; check winter tire requirements for Mount Ashland trips.
plan.goldenHour: The Grouse Gap area on Mount Ashland offers dramatic southern views of the Cascades as the sun sets.
